premises: Thermal aging at ~600°C enhances L12 ordering in FCC domains of AlCoCrFeNi2.1
Thermal aging at ~600°C creates jagged B2/FCC phase boundaries

Jagged phase boundaries act as stress concentrators causing crack initiation and brittle fracture
